question: What will be cost of polishing the curved surface area of a solid cylinder at rate of ₹28 per sq.m, if it has diameter of 70 cm and height of 7 m? ( {{{Use}} {{pi }} {{ = }} frac{{22}}{7}} )

Diameter = 70 cm

Height = 7 m

Curved Surface Area = 2 × π × r × h
